digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Today is Monday, July 27, and the day has six meetings plus one protected focus block, with Legal Change Management, Amazon Connect Venn UAT readiness, and afternoon portfolio roadblocks as the main anchors. There are three carried-over items and one live urgent thread: the travel-document SMS ticket needs early follow-through so IT confirms timing and ownership. No active reminders are queued. Teams thread reads were rate-limited, so Teams context is limited to grounded email notifications and the calendar invites.
